subject: general
question: What is the function of the vacuum valve in the radiator pressure cap?

options.text: Air entering the system during vacuuming

solution:
The correct answer is __Air entering the system during vacuuming**(Option 2)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vacuum valve__ is a component of the radiator pressure cap.
 
• The vacuum valve prevents collapsing of hoses by allowing air to enter the system when the cooling system is under vacuum.
 
• When the coolant contracts upon cooling, the vacuum valve opens to equalize the pressure.
 
• It ensures the reliable operation of the cooling system by maintaining proper pressure balance.
 
• Relieving excess pressure is managed by the pressure relief valve of the radiator cap.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Coolant System Pressure Cap:**

 
 
• It maintains the optimal pressure inside the cooling system.
 
• The pressure cap prevents coolant evaporation and ensures efficient cooling.
 
 
 
• **Pressure Relief Valve:**
 
 
• Located in the radiator cap, it releases excess pressure to protect the cooling system components.
 
• It prevents damage due to over-pressurization when the coolant expands.
